mintAuthority.summary: USG has three mint routes. At finalized Ethereum block 26491610 (2026-11-25T10:30:47Z), the complete authorized market census is 21 markets (matching the 2026-11-22 reserve census at block 26471538, with zero markets added and zero USG or ControlTower role events since): the original 13, plus msETH/OETH, cbBTC/WBTC, reUSD/sDOLA, CVX/ETH, frxUSD/DUSD, frxUSD/crvUSD, crvUSD/ETH/CRV and PYUSD/crvUSD. Fourteen have positive debt shares; authorized markets can remain paused or empty. mintDebt requires isMinter, mintIR requires the sole IRCalculator role and mints to the ControlTower fee treasury, and mintPegKeeper lets the owner mint uncapped USG into either registered peg keeper (each holding 1,500,000 prefunded USG with zero debt after 18,500,000 USG burns per peg keeper at block 26256086). USG, ControlTower, MarketCreator, IRCalculator and all 21 markets share a 3-of-5 Safe (v1.4.1, empty modules, zero guard and moduleGuard) with a custom FeeTreasuryFallbackHandler. The owner can authorize arbitrary minters and change role assignments, so the economic authority remains unbounded.

controls.label: USG token role-gated mint functions
controls.capDescription: The token itself imposes no supply cap on any of mintDebt, mintIR or mintPegKeeper; the only gate is the caller's role mapping. Bounds exist per market (user collateral), not in the token.
controls.evidence: Ethereum block 25531083: USG is not a proxy (EIP-1967 implementation slot = 0x0; verified non-proxy source with no upgrade entrypoint). owner() = 0x461B62CB3A7e9Df8f800aE058AE92F855F2c27Ca, controlTower() = 0xF3f7669dcEED2f985815011C19eD68F667267215, totalSupply = 42993004273104510957389060 (~42.99M USG). Verified source: mintDebt requires isMinter[msg.sender], mintIR requires isIRProducer[msg.sender] and mints to controlTower.feeTreasury(), mintPegKeeper is onlyOwner and requires isPegKeeper[pegKeeper]. No amount cap appears in any of the three.

controls.label: Tangent owner Safe (3/5)
controls.capDescription: Can mint uncapped USG to a registered peg keeper via mintPegKeeper (onlyOwner), and can setIsMinter/setIsIRProducer/setIsPegKeeper on any address. No timelock.

controls.label: Tangent peg keepers with isPegKeeper (2)
controls.capDescription: Peg keepers cannot mint. They are the only addresses the owner Safe may mint into via mintPegKeeper, and the only addresses burnPegKeeper may burn from.

All 21 markets return isMinter = true, isBurner = true, owner() = the 3-of-5 Safe 0x461b62cb3a7e9df8f800ae058ae92f855f2c27ca, and badDebt() = 0; 14 carry positive debt shares. Every market's borrower collateral, exact underlying LP constituents, debt shares, stored interest index and bad debt remain readable on-chain, preserving continuous whole-book accounting. USG totalSupply is 5,706,677.020180795270704171 USG; the two registered prefunded PegKeepers each hold exactly 1,500,000 unused USG (3,000,000 USG combined, reduced from 20,000,000 each on 2026-10-23 at block 26256086) with debt() = 0, leaving 2,706,677.020180795270704171 USG outside prefunded PegKeepers. Across all 21 markets, sum floor(totalDebtShares * IRCalculator.debtIndexes / 1e27) is 2,707,026.058433415979500613 USG and IRCalculator.mintableInterests() is 349.038252620708792688 USG; net minted debt (2,706,677.020180795270707925 USG) matches outside-PegKeeper supply within a 3,754 wei truncation difference. It does not establish an immutable mint cap, independent supervision, stress realizability, future solvency or a holder redemption right. Arbitrary minter grants and uncapped owner PegKeeper minting remain unbounded adverse authority facts.
